obfuscation_indicators: well secured and in process of collection
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and quantitatively detailed, with clear year-over-year performance and balance-sheet metrics. Risk is moderated by declining loan-loss provisions and record earnings, but elevated past-due commercial loans, collateral-dependent recoveries, and interest-rate sensitivity remain material concerns. Some standard qualifications and management judgments limit the precision of forward-looking and asset-quality assessments.
